agent_transfer.diagnostic_experiment: Conduct a learning rate sweep (lr=0.002, 0.001, 0.0008, 0.0005) holding all other hyperparameters constant for 500 steps each.
evidence_against: Empty metrics and prediction_curves prevent direct observation of loss oscillation or gradient explosion.

evidence_for: Current configuration specifies model.lr=0.002, which corresponds to the high-error baseline in K_b10a9ad02e.
